task: Fix a raw-crash concurrent-DONE-race in story_advance and remove a retired review-lane reference from field-regression-cli-smoke.ts
outcome: Terminal transcript for the concurrent-DONE-race fix: two operators run 'lattice story_advance --phase=DONE' on the same story from the same worktree at the same time. One prints 'Story B-xxxx advanced to DONE'. The other now prints 'Cannot advance B-xxxx to DONE: this worktree no longer exists -- a concurrent DONE transition for B-xxxx already completed and removed it. Retry from main.' and exits non-zero -- never a raw 'Error: File not found: .../index.json' stack trace. Terminal transcript for the channel-lane fix: running 'lattice reviewer_list --storyId=B-xxxx --forceReviewer=channel' prints an error containing 'forceReviewer channel is not supported by review_run_start' and exits non-zero, and 'node packages/main/dist/tasks/field-regression-cli-smoke.js' prints '✓ field regression CLI smoke passed' end-to-end with no reference to the retired lane.
facts: transitionLock in transition-orchestrator.ts was rooted at ctx.root, which for a worktree-invoked story_advance is the worktree path itself; a winning DONE deletes that whole worktree as part of cleanup, including any lock directory living under it

ctx.store is bound to ctx.root at CLI bootstrap, before the transition lock is ever acquired, so even a correctly-rooted lock does not protect the loser reading story.readStory(args.storyId) once the worktree it was invoked from no longer exists

StoryArtifactMissingError is intentionally not exported from core/store.ts; existing code in transition-orchestrator.ts already matches it by e.name (duck-typing), not by imported class, at the reconcileReopenAuditBeforeOutOfBandPhaseChange call site

prompt-role-contract-registry.ts hard-asserts lattice-review-channel is status:retired and defaultDispatch:false at registry-construction time; isPromptRoleEligibleForReviewEvidence therefore always returns false for it

PASS_ONLY_REVIEW_FINDING_POLICY in flow-fact-policy.ts already lists channel alongside concept/quality/test-coverage in its wording regex, confirming it was a legitimate lane historically, before being structurally retired

finding_add requires readManifest whenever its desc text matches a pass-only wording pattern; a hand-crafted review pass without a valid _hash and reviewRunId fails validateEvidenceRunBinding's signature and binding checks
DONE for this project requires the full opt-in 3-lane review-assurance-floor quorum (concept, quality, test-coverage), not a single lane

Both fixes were already implemented, RED-then-GREEN verified standalone in the main checkout before this story existed: worktree-authority-smoke.js and field-regression-cli-smoke.js both now pass end-to-end, and both new RED scripts (red-B-new-concurrent-done-race.mjs, red-B-new-retired-channel-lane.mjs) correctly report their target defect is gone
constraints: No changes to prompt-role-contract-registry.ts or flow-fact-policy.ts -- both are already correct; the smoke test was asserting stale behavior against them
No broader refactor of the DONE lifecycle, review-run binding, or reviewer-lane registry beyond the two defects in scope
Preserve the existing narrow-catch-by-e.name pattern for StoryArtifactMissingError rather than exporting the class
